source.text_it: Alcuni veicoli per cava e cantiere hanno il cambio raffreddato ad acqua

records.localized_text: Some quarry and construction vehicles have water-cooled gearboxes.

source.text_it: Il cambio serve a mantenere la velocità rotativa dell’albero di trasmissione costante, indipendentemente dal numero dei giri del motore

records.localized_text: The gearbox keeps transmission shaft rotational speed constant regardless of engine rpm.

source.text_it: Il cambio automatico deve essere disinserito nelle discese ripide

records.localized_text: An automatic gearbox must be disengaged on steep descents.

source.text_it: Se il veicolo è a trazione integrale, significa che tutte le ruote sono motrici

records.localized_text: Four-wheel drive means all wheels are driven.

source.text_it: "Trazione anteriore" significa che sono motrici le sole ruote di uno o più assi anteriori

records.localized_text: Front-wheel drive means only the wheels of one or more front axles are driven.

source.text_it: "Trazione posteriore" significa che sono motrici le sole ruote di uno o più assi posteriori

records.localized_text: Rear-wheel drive means only the wheels of one or more rear axles are driven.

source.text_it: In genere, i veicoli pesanti sono a trazione anteriore

records.localized_text: Heavy vehicles are generally front-wheel drive.

source.text_it: I veicoli dotati di cambio automatico sono in genere a trazione integrale

records.localized_text: Vehicles with automatic gearboxes are generally four-wheel drive.

source.text_it: I veicoli a trazione posteriore devono forzatamente avere motore anteriore

records.localized_text: Rear-wheel-drive vehicles must have front-mounted engines.

source.text_it: La coppia conica è costituita da due ingranaggi sempre in presa, chiamati pignone e corona

records.localized_text: The bevel gear pair consists of two permanently meshed gears called pinion and crown wheel.

source.text_it: La coppia conica serve, tra l’altro, a ridurre la velocità delle ruote rispetto a quella dell’albero motore

records.localized_text: The bevel gear pair, among other things, reduces wheel speed relative to crankshaft speed.

source.text_it: La coppia conica serve, tra l’altro, a deviare di 90° il moto rotatorio dell’albero di trasmissione

records.localized_text: The bevel gear pair, among other things, turns transmission shaft rotation through 90°.

source.text_it: La coppia conica è in genere utilizzata nei veicoli con motore anteriore e trazione posteriore

records.localized_text: The bevel gear pair is generally used in front-engine, rear-wheel-drive vehicles.

source.text_it: Una delle caratteristiche della coppia conica è il rapporto al ponte

records.localized_text: One characteristic of the bevel gear pair is the final-drive ratio.

source.text_it: La coppia conica serve, tra l’altro, ad aumentare la velocità delle ruote rispetto a quella dell’albero motore

records.localized_text: The bevel gear pair, among other things, increases wheel speed relative to crankshaft speed.

source.text_it: La coppia conica serve, tra l’altro, a deviare di 60° il moto rotatorio dell’albero di trasmissione

records.localized_text: The bevel gear pair, among other things, turns transmission shaft rotation through 60°.

source.text_it: La coppia conica è inserita manualmente dall’autista grazie a un comando posto sul cruscotto

records.localized_text: The driver manually engages the bevel gear pair using a dashboard control.

source.text_it: Nella coppia conica, il pignone trasmette il moto alla corona grazie a un disco a frizione

records.localized_text: In the bevel gear pair, the pinion transmits motion to the crown wheel through a friction disc.

source.text_it: Il sincronizzatore è un dispositivo che facilita l'accoppiamento degli ingranaggi del cambio durante il passaggio da una marcia all'altra

records.localized_text: A synchronizer facilitates meshing gearbox gears during gear changes.

source.text_it: Durante la percorrenza di una curva, il differenziale consente di trasferire parte della velocità di rotazione dalla ruota motrice interna a quella esterna alla curva

records.localized_text: On a bend, the differential transfers part of the rotational speed from the inner drive wheel to the outer drive wheel.

source.text_it: La funzione del cambio di velocità è quella di modificare la potenza erogabile alle ruote per vincere più facilmente le resistenze all'avanzamento

records.localized_text: The gearbox modifies power deliverable to the wheels to overcome resistance to movement more easily.

source.text_it: Il differenziale è un meccanismo che consente di evitare lo strisciamento delle ruote durante la percorrenza di una curva

records.localized_text: The differential prevents wheels from sliding while negotiating a bend.

source.text_it: Nei veicoli pesanti le variazioni di massa tra veicolo carico e veicolo scarico sono significative e quindi vengono utilizzati cambi con un numero di rapporti superiore ai cambi utilizzati nei veicoli leggeri

records.localized_text: Heavy vehicles have significant mass differences between loaded and empty states, so they use gearboxes with more ratios than light vehicles.

source.text_it: Nei cambi montati sui veicoli pesanti, lo splitter è una levetta posizionata sotto il pomello del cambio che consente di scegliere tra un gruppo di marce "veloci" e uno di "lente"

records.localized_text: In heavy-vehicle gearboxes, the splitter is a lever beneath the gear knob selecting a group of fast or slow gears.

source.text_it: Il differenziale consente di mantenere una trazione ottimale del veicolo anche su terreni con scarsa aderenza

records.localized_text: The differential maintains optimal traction even on low-grip surfaces.

rows.text: The quiz marks this FALSE, but does not define the cooling arrangement. Some gearboxes can cool oil indirectly through engine coolant; the sources do not confirm a specific combined installation on a construction vehicle.
evidence: Official superiori question 29632 retains its printed verdict.

Volvo oil/coolant exchanger https://stpi.it.volvo.com/STPIFiles/Volvo/FactSheet/TC-MWO%2CTC-MWOH2%2CTC-HWO_Eng_02_338871162.pdf ; Volvo construction vehicles https://www.volvotrucks.com/en-en/transport-solutions/building-construction.html . Combination not independently verified as a specific vehicle.

rows.text: The gearbox changes the ratio between engine and transmission. In gear, output speed varies with engine speed; it is not kept constant independently of it.
evidence: https://web.mit.edu/2.972/www/reports/manual_transmission/manual_transmission.html, MIT, How a Manual Transmission Works: rapporto selezionato fra motore e ruote e velocità degli alberi.

rows.text: On a descent, keep a suitable gear engaged to use engine braking. Selecting neutral breaks that connection and is not required.
evidence: https://www.eaton.com/content/dam/eaton/products/transmissions/vehicle-transmissions/fr-series-manual/eaton-fuller-heavy-duty-transmission-driver-instructions-trdr0515-en-us.pdf, p. 6: non procedere in folle; https://videos.eaton.com/detail/videos/get-2-know-automated-transmissions/video/5856014367001/eaton-get2know-international-driver-training%3A-low-speeds: il comando automatico seleziona marce e freno motore.

rows.text: All-wheel drive can send driving force to all wheels rather than only the front or rear wheels. Actual distribution depends on the system.
evidence: https://press.zf.com/press/en/releases/release_78466.html, ZF, axle drives: la trazione integrale collega anche il ponte posteriore tramite una frizione controllata.

rows.text: With front-wheel drive, driving force reaches the wheels on the front axles; the rear wheels are not driven.
evidence: https://files.eric.ed.gov/fulltext/ED246299.pdf, Power Trains, sezioni trasmissione e assi motori: le ruote motrici ricevono il moto dalla trasmissione.

rows.text: With rear-wheel drive, driving force reaches the wheels on the rear axles; the front wheels are not driven.
evidence: https://media.defense.gov/2014/Jun/20/2002655909/-1/-1/1/140620-N-ZZ182-6551.pdf, NAVEDTRA 14264A, cap. 11, §§ 2.1.4–2.2: pignone e corona, riduzione fissa, rapporto e deviazione a 90°.

rows.text: Heavy vehicles commonly drive the rear axles rather than the front axles. The actual configuration depends on the vehicle.
evidence: https://www.volvotrucks.com/content/dam/volvo-trucks/markets/master/mbc/product_guide_volvo_FM_Euro3-5_eng.pdf, Volvo FM, configurazioni degli assi: gli esempi di autocarri riportano assi motori posteriori.

rows.text: An automatic gearbox selects ratios; all-wheel drive describes which wheels can receive driving force. One does not imply the other.
evidence: https://www.volvotrucks.com/content/dam/volvo-trucks/markets/master/mbc/product_guide_volvo_FM_Euro3-5_eng.pdf, Volvo FM, cambi automatici e configurazioni assi: sono specificati separatamente.

rows.text: Rear-wheel drive identifies the driven wheels, not the engine position: the engine can also be at the rear.
evidence: https://www.maine.gov/future/sites/maine.gov.dafs.bbm.procurementservices/files/pdfs/autoschoolbus15091700000000000056oconnor.pdf, Blue Bird All American Rear Engine specifications: autobus con motore posteriore e ponte posteriore con riduzione ipoide.

rows.text: The pinion meshes with the crown wheel and transfers motion through their teeth. Together they form the final-drive gear pair.
evidence: https://media.defense.gov/2014/Jun/20/2002655909/-1/-1/1/140620-N-ZZ182-6551.pdf, NAVEDTRA 14264A, cap. 11, §§ 2.1.4–2.2: pignone e corona, riduzione fissa, rapporto e deviazione a 90°.

rows.text: The bevel gear pair provides final reduction: the crown wheel turns more slowly than the pinion. This adds to the ratio change produced by the gearbox.
evidence: https://media.defense.gov/2014/Jun/20/2002655909/-1/-1/1/140620-N-ZZ182-6551.pdf, NAVEDTRA 14264A, cap. 11, §§ 2.1.4–2.2: pignone e corona, riduzione fissa, rapporto e deviazione a 90°.

rows.text: In the axle described by the quiz, the longitudinal pinion meshes with the crown wheel and directs motion toward the transverse half-shafts, changing direction by 90°.
evidence: https://media.defense.gov/2014/Jun/20/2002655909/-1/-1/1/140620-N-ZZ182-6551.pdf, NAVEDTRA 14264A, cap. 11, §§ 2.1.4–2.2: pignone e corona, riduzione fissa, rapporto e deviazione a 90°.

rows.text: With a front engine and rear-wheel drive, the longitudinal shaft carries motion to the axle, where the bevel gear pair directs it toward the rear half-shafts.
evidence: https://media.defense.gov/2014/Jun/20/2002655909/-1/-1/1/140620-N-ZZ182-6551.pdf, NAVEDTRA 14264A, cap. 11, §§ 2.1.4–2.2: pignone e corona, riduzione fissa, rapporto e deviazione a 90°.

rows.text: The axle ratio expresses the final-drive reduction and is related to the ratio of crown-wheel teeth to pinion teeth.
evidence: https://media.defense.gov/2014/Jun/20/2002655909/-1/-1/1/140620-N-ZZ182-6551.pdf, NAVEDTRA 14264A, cap. 11, §§ 2.1.4–2.2: pignone e corona, riduzione fissa, rapporto e deviazione a 90°.

rows.text: The axle bevel gear pair reduces speed rather than increasing it: the crown wheel turns more slowly than the pinion.
evidence: https://media.defense.gov/2014/Jun/20/2002655909/-1/-1/1/140620-N-ZZ182-6551.pdf, NAVEDTRA 14264A, cap. 11, §§ 2.1.4–2.2: pignone e corona, riduzione fissa, rapporto e deviazione a 90°.

rows.text: In the axle described by the quiz, the bevel gear pair turns the motion through 90°, from the longitudinal shaft toward the half-shafts, not 60°.
evidence: https://media.defense.gov/2014/Jun/20/2002655909/-1/-1/1/140620-N-ZZ182-6551.pdf, NAVEDTRA 14264A, cap. 11, §§ 2.1.4–2.2: pignone e corona, riduzione fissa, rapporto e deviazione a 90°.

rows.text: The pinion and crown wheel form the final drive and mesh with each other; they are not engaged like a gear using a dashboard control.
evidence: https://media.defense.gov/2014/Jun/20/2002655909/-1/-1/1/140620-N-ZZ182-6551.pdf, NAVEDTRA 14264A, cap. 11, §§ 2.1.4–2.2: pignone e corona, riduzione fissa, rapporto e deviazione a 90°.

rows.text: The pinion transmits motion to the crown wheel through meshing teeth, not through a friction disc.
evidence: https://media.defense.gov/2014/Jun/20/2002655909/-1/-1/1/140620-N-ZZ182-6551.pdf, NAVEDTRA 14264A, cap. 11, §§ 2.1.4–2.2: pignone e corona, riduzione fissa, rapporto e deviazione a 90°.

rows.text: The synchronizer brings the parts to be coupled to compatible speeds before engagement, making gear changes easier.
evidence: https://pergatory.mit.edu/resources/FUNdaMENTALs%20Book%20pdf/FUNdaMENTALs%20Topic%206.PDF, MIT, p. 6-19: il sincronizzatore adegua le velocità prima dell’innesto.

rows.text: In a bend the outer wheel travels farther and must turn faster. The differential allows the two driven wheels to rotate at different speeds.
evidence: https://files.eric.ed.gov/fulltext/ED246299.pdf, Power Trains, p. 268: il differenziale consente alla ruota esterna di girare più velocemente in curva.

rows.text: Changing ratio adjusts wheel torque and speed: a low gear increases available driving force. The gearbox does not create power from nothing.
evidence: https://web.mit.edu/2.972/www/reports/manual_transmission/manual_transmission.html, MIT, How a Manual Transmission Works: rapporto selezionato fra motore e ruote e velocità degli alberi.

rows.text: In a bend the wheels travel different distances. The differential lets them turn at different speeds, avoiding the scrubbing caused by a rigid connection.
evidence: https://files.eric.ed.gov/fulltext/ED246299.pdf, Power Trains, p. 268: il differenziale consente alla ruota esterna di girare più velocemente in curva.

rows.text: A heavy vehicle faces widely varying loads and resistance. More ratios allow a better choice of driving force and engine speed under different conditions.
evidence: https://www.volvotrucks.com/en-en/news-stories/press-releases/2021/mar/volvo-trucks-i-shift-transmission-technology.html, Volvo I-Shift: rapporti crawler per maggior coppia e partenze con carichi pesanti; https://www.volvotrucks.com/content/dam/volvo-trucks/markets/master/mbc/product_guide_volvo_FM_Euro3-5_eng.pdf, Volvo FM, cambi: I-Shift a 12 rapporti.

rows.text: In the type of gearbox described, the splitter control near the knob selects a slow or fast ratio, providing more closely spaced ratios. Control layouts vary between gearboxes.
evidence: https://zinref.ru/avtomobili/Iveco/019_Iveco%20Stralis%20AT_AD_%20italiano_2004/114.htm, manuale Iveco Stralis 2004, figura 125: comando pneumatico splitter, marce gamma lenta e veloce; https://www.eaton.com/content/dam/eaton/products/transmissions/vehicle-transmissions/rt-18/TRDR0800EN-US_0614.pdf, p. 11: selettore splitter L/H e comando di gamma distinti.

rows.text: An open differential allows different wheel speeds but does not guarantee optimal traction on slippery ground: one wheel may spin. A differential lock can improve traction.
evidence: https://www.eaton.com/us/en-us/products/differentials-traction-control/locking-differentials.html, Eaton, Locking Differentials: un bloccaggio migliora la trazione quando una ruota ha poca aderenza.

issues.reason: Il quesito attribuisce FALSO alla possibilità che alcuni veicoli da cava e cantiere abbiano il cambio raffreddato ad acqua; la documentazione Volvo descrive il raffreddamento ad acqua del cambio tramite scambiatore olio/acqua, anche per trasporti pesanti, e offre I-Shift per cantieri. Non è chiarito se la formulazione escluda tale raffreddamento indiretto o quali configurazioni il quesito intenda escludere.
checked_sources: https://stpi.it.volvo.com/STPIFiles/Volvo/FactSheet/TC-MWO%2CTC-MWOH2%2CTC-HWO_Eng_02_338871162.pdf, Volvo Trucks, Gearbox oil cooler, p. 1: le versioni ad acqua raffreddano il cambio tramite uno scambiatore collegato al circuito motore, tra cui I-Shift.
https://www.volvotrucks.com/en-en/transport-solutions/building-construction.html, Volvo Trucks, Building and construction trucks: I-Shift è offerto per impieghi edili.

https://www.eaton.com/content/dam/eaton/products/transmissions/vehicle-transmissions/installation-guides/eaton-lightning-series-transmissions-installation-guide-trig-0580-en-us.pdf, p. 9: uno scambiatore interno olio/acqua raffredda olio del cambio mediante liquido motore.
